text:
maria.marketing: Quick cadence check  final SEO/URL plan for the webinar + short-form launch post tomorrow. Need: final KW list, JSON-LD (Event + VideoObject + mini-HowTo), internal link push map, and a small redirect tidy. Can @ben.seo + @lucas_ops take? doc: https://tiny.redwood/launch-mini

ben.seo: On it. I'll run a SERP cluster & pick 5 long-tail derivatives. Proposed canonical: https://redwood.com/learn/mini-benchmarks-brief. Product /product/benchmarks will be supportive. Seed hero KWs: "LLM inference benchmarks", "inference latency benchmark", "inference cost per token".

ben.seo: Longtails I'll prioritize: "throughput per token vs batch size", "KV cache impact on inference latency", "quantized model latency by GPU", "cost per request for realtime LLM serving", "benchmarks for dedicated inference pools". Will drop suggested meta-description and CTAs into the doc. Use descriptive anchors (no "click here").

lucas_ops: Ran redirect-scan. Findings: /benchmarks-promo -> 302 -> /promo/old; /benchmarks -> 301 -> /learn/old-bench (stale); /benchmarks-archived -> 410. Recommend: 1) 301 /benchmarks-promo -> /learn/mini-benchmarks-brief; 2) change existing /benchmarks 301 target to new canonical; 3) remove /benchmarks-archived.

schema-bot: redirect-check: /benchmarks-promo -> 302. Recommendation: create 301 /benchmarks-promo -> /learn/mini-benchmarks-brief. Commands: `redirect-scan --path /benchmarks*` and `redirect-plan --create 301 /benchmarks-promo /learn/mini-benchmarks-brief --note "consolidate promo paths"`

anya_pm: For the VideoObject we need transcript + captions uploaded to CDN. Also add a short HowTo (3 steps) for "run a quick inference benchmark" so we can target HowTo rich snippets. Provide final canonical + UTM to embed in schema.

lucas_ops: I'll open RED-5001 with the planned 301s, cutover Tue 10:00 PT, rollback 10:30 PT. I'll attach a QA checklist: Screaming Frog crawl, schema-validator run (https://validator.schema.org), canonical tag check, and mobile UA smoke.

deploy-bot: Ticket RED-5001 created and assigned to eng-release. ETA Tue 10:00 PT. Attachments: redirect list + QA steps.

ben.seo: A couple of quick SEO tactics: 1) add rel=canonical pointing to canonical URL on /product/benchmarks and any promo landing; 2) push internal links from high-traffic docs + pricing + case-studies in first 48-72h; 3) set sitemap priority 0.85 for first week and include lastmod=publish date. Also run a short A/B title test: A = "LLM Inference Benchmarks  Latency & Cost | Redwood", B = "Benchmarking LLM Inference: Throughput, Latency, Cost | Redwood" for 48h.

maria.marketing: Love it. Action owners: ben finalize KW list + paste JSON-LD snippets by EOD, lucas create RED-5001 + schedule cutover, anya upload transcript and confirm VideoObject fields. Ping here when each is done. We'll hold promo send until redirects are consolidated. :rocket:

lucas_ops: Will post cutover to #release-war-room once ticket is scheduled. I'll include smoke commands: `screaming-frog --crawl https://redwood.com/learn/mini-benchmarks-brief` and `curl -I https://redwood.com/benchmarks-promo` to confirm 301.

schema-bot: pre-validation note: include `@context": "https://schema.org"`, set `mainEntityOfPage` to canonical without UTMs, and embed VideoObject.transcript as plain text or link to transcript file. Avoid duplicate FAQ content across pages.

maria.marketing: Great. Quick small reminder: anchors should be natural in CTA copy (e.g., "benchmark walkthrough"), avoid repeating exact match anchor more than twice across site. Everyone ack? :white_check_mark:
